question: What immunity to venom is claimed for the practitioner even when bitten by great serpents?
premises: The practitioner may be bitten by great serpents.
Poison would normally enter the body.
In this case poison does not enter the body.
inference: Therefore the accomplished practitioner gains immunity so that poison does not enter the body even when bitten by great serpents.
plain_english: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
